reference: She is said to have trained at altitude all winter.
sk: Hovorí sa, že celú zimu trénovala vo výške.
cz: Říká se, že celou zimu trénovala ve výšce.
acceptable: She is said to have trained at {altitude|high altitude} {all winter|all winter long|the whole winter|throughout the winter}.
She is said to have trained {all winter|all winter long|the whole winter|throughout the winter} at {altitude|high altitude}.
She is said to have been training at {altitude|high altitude} {all winter|all winter long|the whole winter|throughout the winter}.
It is said that she {trained|was training} at {altitude|high altitude} {all winter|all winter long|the whole winter|throughout the winter}.

mistakes.text: She is said to train at {altitude|high altitude} all winter.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Tréning bol v minulosti, preto po „is said“ patrí „to have trained“, nie „to train“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Trénink byl v minulosti, proto po „is said“ patří „to have trained“, ne „to train“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The training happened before, so after “is said” use “to have trained”, not “to train”.

mistakes.text: She is said that she trained at {altitude|high altitude} all winter.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Miešajú sa dve konštrukcie: buď „She is said to have trained“, alebo „It is said that she trained“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Míchají se dvě konstrukce: buď „She is said to have trained“, nebo „It is said that she trained“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Two structures are mixed: use “She is said to have trained” or “It is said that she trained”.

mistakes.text: People say {that |}she trained at {altitude|high altitude} all winter.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Cvičí sa Passive: „She is said to have trained…“ alebo „It is said that…“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Procvičuje se Passive: „She is said to have trained…“ nebo „It is said that…“.
mistakes.feedback_en: This exercise practises the Passive: “She is said to have trained…” or “It is said that…”.

mistakes.text: It says that she trained at {altitude|high altitude} all winter.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „It says“ znamená, že to niekde píše. „Hovorí sa“ je Passive: „It is said“ alebo „She is said to…“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „It says“ znamená, že to někde stojí napsané. „Říká se“ je Passive: „It is said“ nebo „She is said to…“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “It says” means a text says it. For “people say” use the Passive: “It is said” or “She is said to…”.

mistakes.text: She is said to have train at {altitude|high altitude} all winter.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „to have“ patrí tretí tvar slovesa: „to have trained“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „to have“ patří příčestí minulé: „to have trained“.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “to have” you need the past participle: “to have trained”.
